name: @ogygia/tooling
description: The e2e harness the ogygia packages and apps share: each playwright.config.ts calls suite(), each spec uses check(), spawn_server and the regexes (@ogygia/tooling/e2e); a failing test prints its machine moves (e2e fixture, @ogygia/tooling/vitest/trace-setup). The build and test config is @ogygia/config.
